ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major cryptocurrencies slipped on the Delta India exchange, with BTC up modestly while ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP and DOGE fell, keeping the market in a downtrend despite a small BTC gain. Negative sentiment is reinforced by uptober sell-offs, legal pressure on BitGo, and new UK sanctions targeting crypto firms. New token listings on Delta India may provide short-term volume but are unlikely to shift the broader bearish bias.
